title: EIA estimate: 73.62 billion kWh from small-scale solar in 2023
summary: The EIA says it estimates an additional 73.62 billion kWh from small-scale solar photovoltaic systems in 2023, outside the utility-scale table.
body: The same EIA FAQ says the Administration estimates that an additional 73.62 billion kWh of electricity generation in 2023 was from small-scale solar photovoltaic systems. The note defines small-scale systems as generators under one megawatt that are not part of a plant of one megawatt or more, often rooftop systems. The word on the page is estimates. This figure is not a row in the utility-scale table, whose solar total is 165 billion kWh.
